description: Decision 317's subnormal probe (decision 313's finding: the GPU flushes subnormal float32 operands, the CPU reference keeps them), exploratory, under Legacy at 256 px on the 4x2 plane grid, User0-User7 RGB32F on every set. Two authored float32 OpenEXR bitmaps, the lower layer's and the upper layer's: R holds every ordered pair of 16 values (+0, -0, subnormals 2^-149, 3 2^-149, 2^-127, the largest and their negatives, FLT_MIN, FLT_MIN + 1 ulp, 1.5 FLT_MIN, -FLT_MIN, 0.25, 0.5, 1, -0.25), one pair per 16 x 16 texel block; G per texel decision 313's operand classes (a subnormal, a normal in [FLT_MIN, 2 FLT_MIN), a value k/2^24); B normal values locating the block. Per set a lower fill (the lower bitmap, Normal at opacity 1) and an upper fill above it (the upper bitmap), both with Nearest filtering at scale 1. Per channel, the upper fill's mode and opacity: every blend mode but Disable at opacity 1 and 0.7, in order; s0 User0 and s7 User6 the upper fill alone (Normal at 1 on the empty stack), s0 User1 and s7 User7 the lower fill alone. The upper bitmap is also bound as the Normal mesh map of every set (no layer stack between import and export). User0-User7 and normal_base at OpenEXR 32f, passthrough padding, one export step.
